title: Recall of official course labels by candidate depth
description: Recall of the 66 official course prerequisite labels on the 31 labelled targets of the 200-target cohort, against candidate depth from 10 to 1,000 on a logarithmic scale, for the fused multiview pool and the cross-encoder reranking. Both orderings recover 62 of 66 labels at depth 1,000.
